newsitem.title: USA: Mobil says UK approves Shearwater field.
newsitem.headline: Mobil says UK approves Shearwater field.

text.p: Mobil Corp said on Thursday that the UK Department of Trade and Industry had approved the $1.0 billion development of the Shearwater field, in which it has a 16.5 percent stake.
Mobil said that the field will come onstream in the year 2000 and will produce 90,000 barrels of oil equivalent (boe) of condensate and 410 million cubic feet of gas per day.
Its share of the output is 15,000 boe of condensate and 68 million cubic feet of gas.

Mobil said the field, which is 124 miles east of Aberdeen in 295 feet of water, would be operated by Shell Transport and Trading's Shell UK Ltd which has a 28 percent stake, Exxon Corp's Esso Exploration, which has 28 percent and Atlantic Richfield Co's ARCO British Ltd which has 27.5 percent. ((--New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
